scope: Original public-page text/metadata and isolated static build checks; no video watching, business, branch, entrance or media-use approval.

checks.name: Frozen creator HTML SHA256 agrees with retrieval manifest
Video identity, author and full title agree with original JSON without executing page code
Publication date comes from source timestamp and differs from observed/prepared date
All six exact Chinese names, addresses and chapters occur in original description
Exactly one related existing candidate and five unlocated clues contain no invented coordinates
Existing two source points and non-route qualifications remain unchanged
Latest noodles link agrees with guide; historical 2020 link remains
Workbench seed uses individual 25 October/22 October source reading dates
Old workbench base stays stale and cannot become review-ready after content update
Static output has one related map link, five pending markers and no scripts, iframe or seek parameter
Unsafe source protocols and credential URLs reject before overwriting output
Wrong candidate name, missing candidate or elevated map eligibility reject before output changes
Duplicate IDs, mismatched chapter seconds and invalid source dates reject before output changes
Changed playback status requires wording review instead of silently claiming playback tested
Source title HTML is escaped in generated page
